title: Cultivation Calc Component Schema
description: Parameter definitions for cultivation-calc custom actions.

EvaluateCultivationBundleParam.title: EvaluateCultivationBundle Param
EvaluateCultivationBundleParam.description: Optional overrides for EvaluateCultivationBundle. Selected parts and mode/target come from node attach (checkbox/select/input). Empty object uses built-in default cultivation cost table.

bundle_costs.title: Bundle Costs
bundle_costs.description: Map of part key (level/basic_attack/skill/combo/ultimate/trust/talent/base/weapon) to resource needs. Resource keys are IMS item IDs, or COMBAT_RECORD_EXP / COGNITIVE_CARRIER_EXP / WEAPON_EXP / ADVANCED_MATERIAL.
